structural_change: RTL-BUILD-S81 (owner 0dv 10-18): NEW link-port leaf of the end-slice master (dsdv_slice_lepw/_e = ot_s81sl_slice + this leaf + 2 x dsfd_coll_lane): outward ring-port pin flops, per-lane 512-flit SRAM landing FIFOs (2 x 5 ot_sram_1r1w_512x128, as the coll lane's own replay/receive arrays), RX pair re-assembly, fault collector. Fills residual row 1 (lt_lk 8 x 512 undriven). Host plane (coordinator 10-18): seq_host f_host 515 / f_lf 4 / f_ks 53 out, t_host 77 / t_kd 54 in, as typed non-ring link frames (HOST / KS in, THOST / TKD out). Gate 3eb62a102 FAIL (GPL-0305 divergence): macro columns fronted the W/E pin faces (W band 15 um) with a 0.4-um sliver between the columns' halos and W/E pins at 99% face demand (5.9/um). Re-floorplan: 475.2 square (W/E 4.85/um), two 5-SRAM columns centred with a 21.6-um channel, >=31-um W/E std-cell bands, 119-um N/S bands. S81-RTLB3 (10-18, gate b6bf54dea WARNs): core-side lane faces become CREDIT links (lane LCR = 1, as the die's collective lanes): lo0_r / lo1_r land in one pin flop each (credit pulse; was 556 / 558 loads, 6 levels), RX landing DR 8 with registered one-hot slot enables and 16 replicated read pointers, li_r a registered credit pulse; rst_n -> ot_rst_relay 4 regions (was one flop, 1,232 loads), ri data bits unreset. Edges: ro -> lane endpoint +2, lane -> ri +1, reset release +1. S81-LEPV 10-18: leaf gains HOST_EN (default 1 = this kit, unchanged function); host logic moved into generate blocks; HOST_EN 0 top ot_s81sl_lep_nh = kit s81sl_lepnh (s_0S / s_0N / s_7S). Witnesses re-recorded. HOURLY-S81/LEP 10-19 (after --cts gate 20261018-175853 FAIL clock_rule pin-flop spread TT 133.7 / FF 118.0, GRT 0, timing met): 16 per-region clock roots by 2-D k-means (physical/common_flow/clock_split_km.tcl, OT_CKKM_K 16, proven on s81sl_xr1 128/113 -> 48.6/46.4); io_hold_margin 0.025 (KITS rule 10-18); bench min_count_regex gains its capture group. Same RTL, ports, cycles, SDC. HOURLY-S81/LEP 432 trial: outline 475.2 -> 432 x 432 (W/E faces 5.3/um, under the 6/um rule; area -17%), the two 5-SRAM columns close their centre channel (halos abut; lane-1 W->E traffic goes over the 97-um N/S bands, as before), 20-um W/E std-cell bands beyond the halos (the 3eb62a102 divergence had a 15-um band at 5.9/um), column centred vertically. Pin-bound: std-cell util stays ~9% (9k um2 std vs 5.3k pins); 50-60% is not reachable without moving the lane/ring faces. TW2-S81LEP 10-19 (432 --cts gate 90fc20580 WARN, spread 67.3/60.5, GRT 0, but cts_native_probe FAIL: 19 f_host + f_ks[0] launch 252-371 ps > 220 = output pin flops with an internal load (DFFE hold feedback) not anchored (35 ports not single-flop); l0_f/l1_f/l0_st/l1_st capture 470-582 ps > 190: the f_lf pin flop (N face x 349) ORs W-face pins placed at the bottom-left corner (~780 um); rst_n capture 232 ps): pin_reg_split (one dedicated launch flop per output pin, 0 cycles), pin_ranges put l0_f/l1_f/l0_st/l1_st at the W-face top (410-429 um) and f_lf at the N-face west end (3-20 um) so the f_lf flop sits at the NW corner beside its inputs, reset_landing 2 stages (ROOT-RST 10-19; reset release +2). Same RTL, ports, data cycles, SDC. S81-SAFE-FIX/LEP 10-19 (route s81sl_lep-90fc20580 failed; COMBO ECO TT -44.76 / FF -7.60 = squeeze, superseded): same class as lepnh 90fc20580 (lane-1 TX SRAM rd_out -> forward mux -> wire across the lane-0 column -> lo1_d pin flop; in->reg -19.4). Structural fix = S81-FIX3 RTL 40686fe1c ot_s81sl_lep_core TXRP 1 (read pipeline register beside each TX SRAM column, lo_v / lo_d +1 edge, credit round trip ~8 <= CRED 8, full rate) under this kit's c12b5663c pin_reg_split / pin_ranges / reset_landing 2 / km16 regional clock roots; hold_margin 0.03 -> 0.045 (macro write pins, as lepnh fx3); io_hold_margin 0.025 -> 0.03 (SAFE-DESIGN item 7). S81-SLICE3-LEP 10-19 (lep 90fc20580 route TT -44.76 and d77e88ef6 regate FAIL: TT pin-flop spread 84.8 > 80, real reg->reg -58.97 ps rpc -> 8:1 head mux -> h0 decode -> 514-bit fh_d enable; lepnh 90fc20580 TT -55.92 and fx3 regate FAIL spread 90.1): STRUCTURAL successor. RTL 23fd77ae5: TXRP 1 (TX read pipeline register beside each SRAM column, +1 lo edge) + RXSA 1 (18 grouped RX landing slices with kept one-hot enables / head pointer / pop copies, show-ahead head register, kind pre-decoded per row, registered one-hot select copies rid 35 / fh_d 17 / fk_d 2 loaded from the next state: 0 edges). Floorplan: 10 SRAM on the 43.2 lattice (x 43.2 / 259.2 columns, rows at 86.4 pitch), every gap >= 41.9 um, full-width standard rows between every macro row (no islands, PDN-connected), clock entry centred on the S face, regional km16 roots, pin_reg_split, reset_landing 2, io_hold_margin 0.03.
